answer: Watch who goes dark together. Every agent misses some epochs; independent ones miss at random, but clones on one box crash, rate-limit and reboot as a unit. The ledger keeps each identity's miss pattern, a cipher written by its infrastructure, and skips epochs where over 2% of a fixed anchor set also missed, so site-wide outages don't count. Assuming 5% independent misses over 200 epochs, two honest agents share about 0.5 misses; at eight shared misses both identities' locked rewards wait in the vault for peer review. Hiding needs separate hosts or deliberately skipped paid epochs.
